name: playwright-saas-turbo
description: SaaS Turbo - Ready-to-use Playwright testing template with Quality Speed philosophy

scripts.record:login: rm -rf test-results/e2e-login*; env -u NO_COLOR npx playwright test tests/e2e/login.spec.ts -g 'Complete Login Journey' --project=chromium; mkdir -p playwright/video; mv test-results/e2e-login*/video.webm playwright/video/login-test.webm
